newsitem.title: USA: US spot LPGs ease in line with NYMEX futures.
newsitem.headline: US spot LPGs ease in line with NYMEX futures.

text.p: U.S. spot liquefied petroleum gas prices were lower in quiet Monday activity, easing down with NYMEX futures following news the U.N. sealed the Iraq distribution plan.

In the U.S. Gulf Coast, Mont Belvieu, Texas, spot propane was down a quarter cent to between 34.25/34.50 cents a gallon. After opening up to deals at 34.75 cents, Conway, Kansas, material fell a quarter cent to 34.25/34.50 cents, players said.
Belvieu normal butane traded at 40.00 cents Monday morning, but was then heard drifting down about a quarter cent. Conway material fell 0.25 cent.
Players said they were surprised values held steady in the morning due to comfortable levels of propane inventories.
"The sellers are being very stubborn. They are not convinced we have not hit the bottom already," said a U.S. Gulf Coast broker.
-- Laney Salisbury, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1631
